items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch (objection) against the assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter states 'Aufgabe zur Post Samstag, 21.11.2026' and that the notice is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting (§122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, current 4-day rule). Counting 4 days from 21.11.2026 (Sat): 22.11 (Sun, day1), 23.11 (Mon, day2), 24.11 (Tue, day3), 25.11 (Wed, day4) -> deemed Bekanntgabe = 25.11.2026, a regular weekday so no weekend shift applies to the delivery date itself. The one-month Einspruch period (§355 AO) starts the day after Bekanntgabe (§108 Abs.1 AO i.V.m. §187 Abs.1 BGB) and ends, per §188 Abs.2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 25.12.2026. 25.12.2026 (1. Weihnachtstag) and 26.12.2026 (2. Weihnachtstag) are public holidays in NRW, and 27.12.2026 is a Sunday; per §193 BGB the deadline moves to the next business day, 28.12.2026 (Monday).

items.title: Q1 2027 income tax advance payment
items.quote: setzen wir die Vorauszahlungen zur Einkommensteuer ab 2027 auf 1.120,00 € je Quartal fest, fällig jeweils am 10.03., 10.06., 10.09. und 10.12.

warnings: These quarterly advance payments (10.03/10.06/10.09/10.12) continue in subsequent years unless amended or revoked by the Finanzamt; only the 2027 due dates were computed explicitly here.

If your 2027 income will be noticeably lower than in 2025, you can request an adjustment ('Anpassung') of these advance payments by submitting a forecast ('Prognose') to the Finanzamt before relying on these amounts.
